mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real GDP signals strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals strong consumer demand and confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST > 1.3M & UNRATE < 5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2% signals monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs increase and economic growth slows.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS > 200k & UNRATE < 4.5% and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.
